items.stem: On TikTok, the strongest predictor of ad performance is usually:

options.text: Creative quality and a strong opening hook
options.rationale: Correct: native creative and the first seconds drive performance.

options.text: The exact bid set to two decimal places
options.rationale: Bid tuning matters far less than creative on TikTok.

options.text: The number of keywords in the ad group
options.rationale: TikTok is not keyword-driven like search.

options.text: The colour of the call-to-action button
options.rationale: A minor factor compared with the creative itself.

items.explanation: Correct: native creative and the first seconds drive performance.

items.stem: Which TWO are sound principles of structured creative testing? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Change one variable at a time so results are attributable
options.rationale: Correct: isolating variables keeps tests interpretable.

options.text: Let a test gather enough conversions before judging it
options.rationale: Correct: early data is noisy and misleads.

options.text: Pause any ad with a low score in its first hour
Test twenty variables in a single ad group at once
options.rationale: Confounds results; you cannot attribute the effect.

items.explanation: Correct: isolating variables keeps tests interpretable.
